cards.question: What is the function of Plasma B Cells?
cards.answer: Synthesize and secrete antigen-specific antibodies (IgG, IgM, IgA, IgE).

cards.question: Which enzyme converts angiotensin I to angiotensin II?
cards.answer: Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE), predominantly in pulmonary vascular endothelium.
